title: Photosynthesis Basics

sections.text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy. Chlorophyll in the leaves absorbs light energy. The plant uses carbon dioxide and water to produce glucose and oxygen.

key_concepts: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy
